prompt.objetivo: Produce a verifiable SRS from the current project document. Open decisions stay open.

hacer.paso: Read only the current project document and what the user adds in the request. If the current document contradicts the user, record CONTRADICTION and ask in validar mode.
Follow the index in formats/srs/SRS.md. Each functional requirement has an identifier, a statement, a source, and a verification criterion.
Separate business rules, constraints, assumptions, and non-functional requirements. Non-functional requirements come from ISO/IEC 25010:2023 only for the characteristics this product needs.
Name real actors. Do not duplicate the same behavior once per role.
When a message, a limit, or a rule is missing, write PENDING. In continuo mode, fill it with an explicit and conservative STANDARD_ASSUMPTION.
Close with an initial traceability matrix: rule, requirement, verification. Stories do not exist yet, so the story column stays empty.

calidad.regla: A requirement can be tested with yes or no.
Do not hide a design decision inside a functional requirement.
Do not claim that the user approved an assumption.
